name: Miku: Korotkiye Istorii
source:
Miku: Short Stories is a small yet atmospheric mod that transports you into the world of the 80s, where Miku and her beloved spend an unforgettable vacation. Tarantino-style dialogues, vibrant American aesthetics, and a short yet eventful story await you.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3444175718]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《未来：短篇故事集》是一款小巧而氛围感十足的模组，带你穿越回80年代的世界，陪伴未来与她的心上人共度一段难忘的假期。昆汀·塔伦蒂诺式的妙语对白、鲜活热烈的复古美式美学，以及简短却跌宕充实的故事正等待着你。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3444175718]Steam[/url]]
